items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 149:1
items.html: (To the question) It is known that the four kings of HGT are the aspect of the upper-lower of the upper AVI of Nekudim, and the four kings of TNHYM are the aspect of the upper-lower of the YESHSUT of Nekudim. And the backs of AVI, which were nullified at the time of the breaking of the vessels, fell to the place of HGT; and the backs of YESHSUT fell to the place of TNHYM, as said in Part 7, see there. And it is known that the essence of ZA is from the chest and above, but from the chest and below is the aspect of the Nukva. Hence, ZA raises the backs of AVI, because they fell to his place, to the place of HGT, which were his heads. But the backs of YESHSUT belong to the Nukva, for they fell to the place of the four kings of TNHYM, which are the aspect of the Nukva, as above. (Item 189, and in Pnimi, Sub Header “At the death”).
